findings.title: ML / Quantitative: $30,000 capital, zero positions
findings.observation: Pod 'ML / Quantitative' has a $30,000 budget and currently holds $30,000 with zero open positions.
findings.why_wrong: idle capital earns zero return and represents a failure to execute on the pod's mandate.

findings.title: ST model AUC 0.545 — barely above random; weak edge
findings.observation: The model's holdout ensemble AUC is 0.5448 (walk-forward ±0.066) (CV mean 0.5448). That is only marginally better than a coin flip and well below the 0.57 live-trading gate.
findings.why_wrong: A model this weak provides little real edge. Sizing capital to it implies more confidence than the evidence supports.
findings.suggestion: Keep the model out of live buys until AUC clears the gate. Pursue feature expansion / retraining (see model_test_harness.py weekly report) before raising its capital weight.
